description: This file defines the Subscription class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling email notifications related to subscription and order status updates. It contains methods for processing subscription data, generating email content, and queuing email tasks.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for handling email notifications related to subscriptions and order status updates within Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles subscription-related email notifications after a subscription is added or modified, generating email content and queuing email tasks.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Handles order status change notifications, generating email content and queuing email tasks for order updates.
